_id.description: Unique identifier of the document. Pattern: 16-digit numeric string, unique across the database

recordNo.description: Business identifier of the document, readable by people and unique within the site

app.description: Application context of the document: Auto = automotive caliper MES, Gamp = pharmaceutical GMP, Common = reference data shared by both

siteId.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_site._id: the site the document belongs to

siteName.description: Display value of the site, copied from u_mes_mast_site.name

title.description: Title of the maintenance work order; used as its display value in other collections

equipmentName.description: Display value of equipmentId, copied from u_mes_mast_equipment.name

toolName.description: Display value of toolId, copied from u_mes_maint_tool.name

maintenancePlanName.description: Display value of maintenancePlanId, copied from u_mes_maint_maintenancePlan.name

downtimeEventName.description: Display value of downtimeEventId, copied from u_mes_perf_downtimeEvent.recordNo

priority.description: Priority of the maintenance work order

reportedById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user recorded for 'reported'

reportedBy.description: Display name of the user in reportedById, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName

reportedAt.description: Date and time when the record was reported. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

reasonCodeName.description: Display value of reasonCodeId, copied from u_mes_perf_reasonCode.name

plannedStartAt.description: Planned start date and time. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

startedAt.description: Date and time when the record was started. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

completedAt.description: Date and time when the record was completed. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

equipmentReleasedById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user recorded for 'equipment released'

equipmentReleasedBy.description: Display name of the user in equipmentReleasedById, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName

equipmentReleasedAt.description: Equipment released date and time. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

shiftName.description: Display value of shiftId, copied from u_mes_mast_shift.name

rootCauseCodeId.description: Reference to u_mes_perf_reasonCode._id: root cause code

rootCauseCodeName.description: Display value of rootCauseCodeId, copied from u_mes_perf_reasonCode.name

closureApprovedById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user recorded for 'closure approved'

closureApprovedBy.description: Display name of the user in closureApprovedById, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName

andonEventName.description: Display value of andonEventId, copied from u_mes_plan_andonEvent.description

priorityScore.description: Priority score from criticality, due risk and production impact (0 to 100)

schedulingSource.description: How the work order was prioritised and scheduled

slaResponseDueAt.description: Time by which a technician must respond

slaRepairDueAt.description: Time by which the repair must be complete

status.description: Primary lifecycle state of the document

schemaVersion.description: Version of this collection's document structure, starting at 1

createdAt.description: Date and time the document was created. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

createdById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user or process that created the document

createdBy.description: Display name of the creator, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName

updatedAt.description: Date and time of the most recent update. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

updatedById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user or process that last updated the document

updatedBy.description: Display name of the last updater, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName
